checks: The setup helper created real native specialists, departments, scoped owner authority and persistent tool assignments without starting a job.
A real stdio MCP client discovered the native employee assignment and verified Blender through the authenticated HTTP runtime.
The real native grant admitted a bounded Blender CPU render through stdio MCP and HTTP, producing a hash-verified 64 by 64 PNG and durable receipt.
The same MCP command replayed before and after complete daemon/client restart without a second creative job.
Revoking the actual native grant rejected a fresh MCP render while preserving the original receipt; no provider job or call was created.
All MCP clients, runtime controllers and disposable native/project state were closed and removed before publishing success.
